example.title: Wharfinger Building, New Bedford (the old fish auction house)

brief: A small two-storey red-brick harbour office with a slate hip roof and white cupola, on the fish pier among the draggers; the port's fish auction was held here. One photo. Older than 1970 (1934): the only fish-auction building on Commons. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Fish Auction
